datasets.title: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Democratic Republic of the Congo with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/democratic-republic-of-the-congo-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded datasets, assigning representative points, and creating Voronoi-based catchment polygons. Population data from multiple sources (WorldPop, Grid3, Kontur, Meta) were aggregated and disaggregated by sex and age. Building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets at varying confidence thresholds.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to disaggregate settlement populations

sources.name: Grid3
sources.description: Gridded population data from 2023 used for settlement population estimation

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: Gridded population dataset from 2023 contributing to settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Population data disaggregated by sex and age groups from 2023

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data from 2024 for settlement building counts

sources.name: Google
sources.description: Machine learning-detected building footprints at multiple confidence levels from 2023
